name: Industrial gas turbine (aeroderivative and heavy-frame)
description: Gas turbine for power generation and mechanical drive, in two families: aeroderivative units adapted from jet engines (fast start, high simple-cycle efficiency, modular exchange) and heavy-frame machines built for bulky base-load duty behind the grid or as compressor drives on pipelines and gas plants. Sets the exhaust energy that an HRSG converts in combined-cycle and cogeneration service.
applications: grid power generation, simple cycle and combined cycle
mechanical drive for pipeline and gas-plant compression
